how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the sum of the series selected of the particular instrument.

SUM is generally used under the position keyword

This keyword has 2 inputs, one is to select the series, other is to select the period which is the no. of previous values to consider to add

![Example](./images/img-1632309264.png)

The above condition will return the sum of the previous 3 close prices of   NIFTY 50
